column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 2 Golgotha prison / Gaius (verified subset)
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Hey, big guy.
Do you know the saying, "Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know"?
Truth is... the people caught up in an incident are always happier not knowing it!
I'm $$ガイウス$$! They call me $$疾風のガイ$$!!
Then you must be...
the champion of $$正義$$ the poor praise...
the one rumored to have raided and slaughtered the homes of more than two hundred powerful men...
and then gone around handing the stolen money to worthless poor people...
That hypocrite they call $$ガイ$$?!
I can look to heaven without shame.
If I hadn't been caught, theft and murder would be acts the black $$羽$$ applaud!
The only problem is that my $$羽$$ are white...
I've never felt even a little ashamed of what I've done!
But I've heard of you too.
They say that, while you were a $$奴隷$$ in $$パンデモニウム$$, you even killed the $$領主$$ who owned you...
and set off wandering in pursuit of something called $$自由$$, which never existed in $$この世$$ to begin with...
a muscle-brained $$逃亡奴隷$$ named $$レブロブス$$ who knows nothing of the world!
Heh. To black $$羽$$, being $$弱者$$ is already a grave $$罪$$...
We're $$罪$$ful criminals fit for prison, but we're a hundred times better than that coward $$ピリポ$$.
Come to think of it, I've heard something...
Supposedly, some years back, the $$大神官$$ of the $$太陽の神殿$$ lost a power struggle...
and was locked away in this $$ゴルゴダ$$ prison.
That musclehead over there probably doesn't know, but...
the black $$羽$$ believe that they are descendants of the gods who survived the $$創世記戦争$$...
of myth.
Among those black $$羽$$, the ones called $$大神官$$ are said to
be closest to the gods—objects of awe and terror.
After all, $$大神官$$ supposedly have horns growing from their heads,
and can wield $$魔道$$ beyond anything ordinary people could imagine.
